title: Evolving to Match Capabilities: Improving Harness Self-Evolution via Skill Adaptation
why: Shows harness self-evolution (skills revised from trajectories, weights fixed) fails when skills mismatch executor capability; adds a fixed meta-skill that guides skill adaptation in a five-round self-evolution loop, lifting weak-to-strong executors by 2.0–5.1 points over the same loop without it.
mechanism: meta-skill-guided skill adaptation inside harness self-evolution loop (parameters frozen)
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: 103 skill-sensitive pairs across SkillsBench/DocOps/Tessl; seven executors; one-shot Kimi-K3 adaptation +5.1–14.1 on weak executors; five-round self-evolution +2.0–5.1 with meta-skill vs without.
retrieval_notes: Tue 27 Oct cs.AI/CL/LG new listing; abs+HTML opened. Project page zhihaoyang30.github.io/skill-adaptation noted; code promised post-review. Not in corpus/inbox.
